<!-- pr-reviewer: 55e9164d4ae02c3ea295c2fe5d43ff645e962789 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** (Quick pass held, PR flagged ready; full review below.)

What looks good
- Test-only plus a decision file; no product code, no snapshot PNG, no process files, no new dependency.
- Both new tests read the painted textured rects and require the kind glyph level with the row/item, scrolling each into view first. The decision note explains the earlier "no glyph" as a clip-rect artefact.

Local results (head merged with current main: already up to date, no conflicts)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib tool_icon_wiring` (CWD crates/ui) | 4 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| Mutation: comment out `glyph(...)` in the catalog row (pages.rs:871) | `every_catalog_row_paints_its_kind_glyph` fails ("catalog row EM-0200-2FL paints no EndMill glyph"), the rest pass |
| Mutation: comment out `glyph(ui, icon)` in `tool_combo` (tool_icons.rs) | `every_picker_item_paints_its_kind_glyph` fails ("picker item EM-0200-2FL paints no EndMill glyph"), the rest pass |

Both mutations restored; worktree clean.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes (not blocking)
- The body says the `tool_of_kind` comment is corrected, but the diff only adds lines (80 additions, 0 deletions) and touches no such comment. Worth fixing the body wording or adding the comment.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- review-cost: 55e9164d4ae02c3ea295c2fe5d43ff645e962789 -->

| Run | Model | Tokens | Est. cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| issue worker (effort:low, escalated) | Haiku 5.5 | 141k | ~$0.02 |
| issue worker (effort:medium) | Sonnet 5.5 | 108k | ~$0.30 |
| review | Sonnet 5.5 | 79k | ~$0.22 |
Blended upper estimate (90 % input / 10 % output at list price; cache reads make the real cost lower). Main-session coordination isn't counted. Model per run is taken from the agent tier and may differ.
Effort: effort:medium (escalated from effort:low)
